Summaries.eng: This work depicts the lives of the dwarfs living on Korokkuru Island, and the main characters are twin dwarfs Chifuru and Tafuru.
Summaries.jpn: コロックル島に住む小人たちの生活を描いた作品で、チフル（妹）とタフル（兄）の双子の小人が主人公。

Titles.jpn: 森の神様 フォーラボー

Summaries.eng: While searching for nuts, Tiffel and Taffel wander into the forest and see a white owl. Back home, their grandfather tells them that they have met Fara, the protector of the forest. Although they are technically forbidden to go into the forest, the children secretly set out to search for Fara again the next day.

A fox has washed ashore on the island, and the elves, fearing the predator, barricade themselves in their village. Not so for Tiffel and Taffel: Worried about a sick mother rabbit and her children, they secretly leave the house. When they are surprised by the fox in the rabbit hole, the situation seems hopeless. But Tiffel has an idea.

Titles.jpn: なんて素敵なプレゼント

Summaries.eng: A wedding is about to be celebrated in the village. Tiffel and Taffel want to surprise the bride and groom with a wedding carriage and decorate an old wooden cart with daisies. But before the dream vehicle can be used, the hedgehog encounters a mishap.

Taffel dreams of flying. Even a belly landing with a pair of homemade wings can't dissuade him from his dream. When he spots a flying squirrel in a tree, he's fascinated. He's determined to get to know this strange creature better.

Titles.jpn: 祭の夜 オスカが呼ぶ

Summaries.eng: Ever since Tiffel was attacked by a snake, she hasn't dared to leave the house. Not even the Festival of Lights can entice her, even though she made a ghost figure especially for it. Then Taffel has an idea: This very ghost will ensure that his sister can still participate in the festival.

Tiffel and Taffel go on a canoe trip with their father, Krischan. They meet the kingfisher Schnapp, encounter a badger, and go down rapids. When Krischan gets out to help a friend, Taffel's carelessness causes the canoe to break away from the bank and drift away with the twins.

Titles.jpn: ぼくらの夏が飛んでいく

Summaries.eng: Tiffel, Taffel, and their friends are allowed to spend the night in their treehouse by the river. When their fathers try to scare them by disguising themselves as ghosts, they are tricked by the children themselves. The next day, a severe storm approaches. They rush home to the village, where they shelter from the coming storm. When it's over, the children are only interested in one thing: Did their summer house survive the storm?

Titles.jpn: 笛の音は秋風にのって…

Summaries.eng: Hanna is supposed to play the flute solo at the big autumn concert. But during an argument between Tiffel and Taffel, her flute falls and disappears. Hanna sends the children to their flute teacher to get a replacement. But the new flute also goes missing.

Titles.jpn: フェアリーリングの真ん中で

Summaries.eng: Tiffel and Taffel discover a magical mushroom circle in the forest and are magically whisked away to Mapo Mapo Land by the good mushroom spirits. They enjoy it so much that they forget their grandfather's warning: Anyone who stays in Mapo Mapo too long will fall into the hands of the evil mushroom goblins.

Titles.jpn: 感謝祭の夜のできごと…

Summaries.eng: Like every year, Tiffel, Taffel, and their friends dress up as pumpkin ghosts for Thanksgiving and haunt the village in honor of the earth spirit Orum. As they come to a lonely forest path, Tiffel suddenly sees a glowing figure.

Titles.jpn: オスカが家にやって来た

Summaries.eng: Grandma Melina is seriously ill. Even the doctor is at a loss. Desperate, Tiffel and Taffel write a letter to Orum, the earth spirit, asking for his help. At home, they anxiously await a response. Will Orum come to visit them?

Titles.jpn: 明日 天気になあれ…

Summaries.eng: Tiffel, Taffel, and their friends are playing hide-and-seek in a remote storage room in the snow-covered village. As Tiffel and Taffel sneak out, an avalanche blocks their way back. Freezing, the children try to find their way home through the deep snow. Then they are attacked by a hungry eagle.

Barbo the swan loses a leg in an accident and is nursed back to health by the Krockel family so he's strong enough for the flight north. But when the swans set off on their journey, Barbo is left behind alone. Will he be able to keep up with the others?
